item.title: REF 0.3.0
item.description:
• Sync in the zoomed waveform: switching between the reference and your mix (R, M) lands the song you switch to on the same beat in the bar as the one you heard, in step while both play. Line up (L) puts the other song at the same bar and beat.
  • Sones: the LUFS button beside Fix level-matches the A/B by how loud the songs sound (ISO 532-1), not only by their LUFS.
  • Genre-sized reference sets: drop 20 to 200 songs on Reference. Summary shows where your mix sits among them and its closest songs, each one click from the A/B; Over time draws the set as a band.
